semantics.note: Firm present-tense observation. In context the $440M figure is revenue outside the top two customers. The normalised text drops that scope, but the contract restores it.

contract.note: Narrowing to 2024 revenue outside the top two customers follows the speaker's own $440M explanation, so it is a fair ordinary reading. 'Meaningful' has no threshold, so the result depends on judging adequacy relative to scale.

evidence.note: Audited 2024 figures from the FY25 10-K, available before the cutoff: $1,915M revenue, top-two shares of 62% and 15%. That leaves about $440M, which confirms the premise but gives no utilization or scale benchmark for meaningfulness.

reviews.rationale: The numerical premise (about $440M of 2024 revenue outside the top two customers) is confirmed. The packet has no utilization, customer-level, or scale-comparison evidence to show whether that demand was commercially meaningful, so neither the support nor the contradiction condition is met.
